# Urban sketch recipe

A sketchbook page drawn on location. A thin sepia fineliner wobbles, overshoots corners and never quite closes. Loose transparent watercolour sits on top, a little off the lines. The page begins as bare pen sketch; colour floods in through irregular wet-edged masks while the camera drifts. Warm paper, handwriting in the margins.

## Two layers
Reportage drawing, done in minutes. Ink and wash stay visibly separate.

Ink:
- One near-constant line, about 2-3 px at 1920 wide (1.2-1.8 px for details), always the same dark colour.
- Drawn stroke by stroke. Wobble about 1 px, corner overshoot about 5 px.
- Hint, do not itemise: window ticks rather than a grid; a few scalloped arcs rather than a full tree contour.

Wash:
- Transparent colour laid after the line, misregistered 3-4 px from it.
- Edge pooled darker, interior paler. Bare paper stays for highlights and figures.
- It arrives through a growing irregular mask (see Colour arrival).

The paper belongs to the picture: mottling and fine tooth over everything, nothing painted edge to edge.

Never: whiteboard explainer (no marker, no diagrams); ink-wash brush painting without a line; clean vector illustration. Line plus wash, always.

## Build notes
- Paper: brand background with a large mottle and a fine tooth. Paint once from `--teks` at 2-10 % alpha and lay it over every scene. It never moves.
- Pen line: smoothed polyline, a point every ~18 px nudged by +-1.3 px, round caps, `pathLength` 1 so it draws on via `stroke-dashoffset`. Split long straights into several strokes; no ruler lines.
- Wash shape: rough polygon with an edge point every ~14 px (+-3 px), 45-70 % opacity, shifted (+4, +3) off its line. Inside it, a second paper-coloured polygon at 93 % size and 26 % opacity darkens the rim. A building takes four layers: facade, shadow side (violet, 30 %), roof, awning.
- Foliage: pale base wash, then hundreds of small tilted dabs coloured by light direction (dark at lower right, yellow-green at upper left), with holes at the rim. Paint once to a bitmap and move it as one picture.
- Sky: a few wide soft ellipses at about 45 %, one pale blue, overlapping. Keep the blank text margin clear.
- Figures: a tiny stick-and-wash walker, blank face, paper halo behind it so it reads over busy areas.

## Colour
- Ink: `--teks`, never changes. Paper: `--latar`, the brightest value, reserved, not painted.
- `--utama`: foliage and the "go" colour (grass, leaf dabs, a key underline).
- `--aksen`: warm accent (roofs, awnings, pins, route line, the walker's shirt).
- Words and lines on the page use `--utama-di-latar` and `--aksen-di-latar`. Pin numbers sit on `--aksen` in `--teks-di-aksen`.
- Fixed materials, not brand-driven: sky blue `--langit`, stone `--batu`, shadow violet `--ungu`, leaf yellow and leaf green for the foliage ramp. Facades mix these with the brand via `color-mix`, so a new brand tints the whole town.
- Withholding colour is allowed. Ink-only page, then colour as an event: that is the signature rhythm.

## Type
All text is handwriting, written on left to right with a soft wet edge. `--font-judul` and `--font-isi` are both Caveat 700.
- Titles 110-160 px; key figures 300+ px; notes 56-76 px; chips 46 px.
- Place text on blank paper. To cross a drawing, use a small paper-coloured chip sized to its text. Never on a wash.

## Colour arrival (signature)
- Paint the whole street once on a canvas about 1.5x frame width: dense overlapping foliage in three greens with darker pooled rims, a blue sky wash with paper-white cloud gaps, warm and cool shophouses.
- Reveal it through ten overlapping soft ellipses, each growing over 3 s (`sine.inOut`, radius up to ~650-720 px, feather 42 %).
- Five start at the beginning; five fire mid-film as the camera reaches the unpainted half.
- Lines stay unpainted until their colour arrives.

## Timing
- Shot: one continuous camera move, a 10.8 s pan of about 1080 px along the long street (`power1.inOut`). Handwritten stop labels live on the street and appear as the camera passes. One page turn at most, into the closing page.
- Ink: 0.7-1.0 s per building, strokes staggered 0.05-0.12 s. Route line: constant speed over 2.2 s (`ease: "none"`).
- Wash: starts 0.4-0.7 s after its line. Opacity 0 to 1 and scale 0.72 to 1 from the middle, `power2.out`, 0.9 s, stagger 0.05-0.25 s. Colour never snaps.
- Handwriting: mask edge sweeps over 0.5-1.1 s, linear.
- Closing page: turns in over 0.7 s, `power2.inOut`, shadow along the left edge.
- Walkers: a step every 0.4 s, legs and arms swing +-20 / +-13 px, `sine.inOut`.
- Final page: fully still for at least 2 s.

## Camera
- Slow lateral pan following a walking figure: travel, a street unrolling. Tour, delivery route, commute.
- Push-in while the pen draws: a detail noticed. Shopfront, dish, tool.
- Page turn from the right, once: arrival at the closing page. Contact page, recap.
- Pull back to the whole page: the sketch as an object, a summary. Contact page, recap.
- Tilt into the margin: picture to words. Note, date, title.
- Hold still while the pen draws: noticing as an act. Use on the subject being drawn.

Transitions: page turns or colour arriving. No dissolves.

## Signature moves
- Colour arrival: the pen sketch stands alone, then colour floods in through wet-edged blobs as the camera drifts. Fits: neighbourhood tour, cafe terrace, garden class, travel diary.
- Pen draw-on, then wash: line first, colour follows off-register. Fits: street or shop profile, a class's studio, a bakery's story, a travel diary page.
- Stops written on the street: numbered pins and handwritten chips appear as the camera passes. Fits: walking tour, delivery or event route, a four-stop how-to, a tutor's lesson plan.
- Small walker: a figure crossing the page on the beat. Fits: a guide, a customer, a creator's persona, the reader of a story.
- Giant handwritten figure with a pen underline. Fits: distance, price, duration, member or lesson count.
- Foliage as dabs: leaf masses that bloom over the buildings. Fits: park or garden, cafe terrace, nature class, seasonal story.
- Page turn to a closing page: pull back to the whole sketch, contact lines written in the margin. Fits: any call to action, such as a booking, sign-up or meet-up.

## Avoid
- A perfect line or flat vector fill. Wobble, overshoot and misregistration are the look.
- Wash that stays exactly inside the lines, or covers the page edge to edge.
- Text over wash or foliage. Use blank paper or a chip.
- Clipped chips: size the box to its text.
- Heavy texture that dulls text on a dark brand. Keep tooth under 10 % alpha.
- Repainting foliage or paper each frame. Paint once, move the bitmap.
- Ghost-pale paint on bare paper: where colour has arrived, the layer must be dense.

# Urban sketch: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.8, medium 2.8, long 4.

## hook

- en: the page sits as an unpainted pen sketch; colour floods in through irregular wet-edged blobs while the camera drifts along the street
- id: halaman berupa sketsa pena tanpa warna; warna mengalir masuk lewat gumpalan basah tak beraturan, kamera bergeser di sepanjang jalan

## problem

- en: ink only, colour withheld: a quiet line-only drawing of what is wrong, one small patch of wash arriving as the cause is named
- id: hanya garis tinta, warna ditahan: sketsa sunyi tentang masalahnya, satu noda cat datang saat penyebabnya disebut

## fact

- en: a handwritten note beside a quick sketched detail; the pen underlines the key word and a dab of wash lands on it
- id: catatan tulisan tangan di samping detail sketsa cepat; pena menggaris bawahi kata kunci dan satu noda cat jatuh di situ

## step

- en: stops written on the street itself: a numbered pin pops and a handwritten label appears as the camera passes each one
- id: pemberhentian ditulis di jalan itu sendiri: pin bernomor muncul dan label tulisan tangan tampil saat kamera lewat

## compare

- en: two sketches on one page, the left in ink only and the right washed in colour, a handwritten label under each
- id: dua sketsa di satu halaman, kiri hanya garis dan kanan diberi cat air, label tulisan tangan di bawahnya

## number

- en: the figure written huge by hand on the blank paper beyond the painted edge, a pen underline drawn under it, held alone
- id: angka ditulis besar dengan tangan di kertas kosong di balik tepi lukisan, digaris bawahi pena, ditahan sendirian

## proof

- en: a page turn to a new spread: a tiny sketched portrait or place with a handwritten quote and date in the corner
- id: halaman dibalik ke lembar baru: potret atau tempat kecil dari sketsa dengan kutipan tulisan tangan dan tanggal di pojok

## offer

- en: the page pulls back to show the whole sketch, the offer written in the blank margin and circled once with the pen
- id: halaman ditarik mundur menampilkan seluruh sketsa, penawaran ditulis di margin kosong dan dilingkari sekali dengan pena

## cta

- en: pull back to the full page; contact lines written on left to right in the margin, then a still hold of at least two seconds
- id: tarik mundur ke halaman utuh; kontak ditulis dari kiri ke kanan di margin, lalu diam sedikitnya dua detik

## payoff

- en: the finished page settles: last wash dab, handwritten sign-off with date and place, held still
- id: halaman selesai berhenti: noda cat terakhir, tanda tangan tulisan tangan dengan tanggal dan tempat, ditahan diam

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1920, height=1080" />
    <title>Sketsa kota</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Caveat"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #f5eede; --latar-2: #ebe2cb; --utama: #7fa04a; --aksen: #c9573f;
        --teks: #2b2520; --teks-redup: #6b5f52; --teks-di-utama: #1c2410; --teks-di-aksen: #fff6ec;
        --utama-di-latar: #4f6e2a; --aksen-di-latar: #b04630;
        --font-judul: "Caveat", "Noto Sans", cursive; --font-isi: "Caveat", "Noto Sans", cursive;
        /* Bahan sketsa yang tetap di semua brand: langit, batu, bayangan ungu, daun. */
        --langit: #9fbcd6; --batu: #d8c6a0; --ungu: #7a7490; --daun-terang: #d6d56f; --daun-gelap: #3f5d36;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1920px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 1920px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      .page { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1920px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; }
      #p4 { background: var(--latar); }
      /* Tepi halaman yang dibalik: bayangan di sisi kiri. */
      .turn::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 80px; height: 100%; z-index: 9; background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 32%, transparent), transparent); }
      .cam { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1920px; height: 1080px; transform-origin: 0 0; }
      .lay { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; overflow: visible; }
      svg { overflow: visible; }
      .fol { position: absolute; }
      /* Garis pena: satu warna tinta, digambar lewat dashoffset. */
      .ink { fill: none; stroke: var(--teks); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-dasharray: 1 3; stroke-dashoffset: 1; }
      .fix { stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
      .mez { fill: none; stroke: none; }
      .halo { fill: var(--latar); opacity: 0.88; }
      .shirt { fill: var(--aksen); stroke: var(--teks); stroke-width: 2; }
      .head { fill: var(--latar); stroke: var(--teks); stroke-width: 2; }
      .hair { fill: var(--teks); }
      .bag { fill: var(--utama); stroke: var(--teks); stroke-width: 2; }
      .pin { fill: var(--aksen); stroke: var(--teks); stroke-width: 2.5; }
      .pn { fill: var(--teks-di-aksen); font: 700 40px var(--font-judul); text-anchor: middle; dominant-baseline: central; }
      /* Tulisan tangan: tepi basah bergerak dari kiri (--p). */
      .t { position: absolute; white-space: nowrap; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; padding: 0 0.12em 0.1em 0; color: var(--teks); }
      .tulis { --p: -12%; mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, black calc(var(--p) - 0.7em), transparent var(--p)); }
      .chip { position: absolute; white-space: nowrap; font: 700 46px/1 var(--font-isi); color: var(--teks); background: var(--latar); padding: 6px 18px 12px; border-radius: 12px; }
      #kertas { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1920px; height: 1080px; z-index: 50; pointer-events: none; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <div class="page" id="p1" data-role="hook"><div class="cam" id="c1"></div></div>
      <div class="page" id="p2" data-role="step"><div class="cam" id="c2"></div></div>
      <div class="page" id="p3" data-role="number"><div class="cam" id="c3"></div></div>
      <div class="page turn" id="p4" data-role="cta"><div class="cam" id="c4"></div></div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const tok = (n) => getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(n).trim();
      const rgb = (h) => [1, 3, 5].map((i) => parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
      const mix = (a, b, t) => a.map((v, i) => v + (b[i] - v) * t);
      const rgba = (c, a) => `rgba(${c[0] | 0},${c[1] | 0},${c[2] | 0},${a})`;
      const [A, B, Lg, U, V, LT, DK] = ["--aksen", "--batu", "--langit", "--utama", "--ungu", "--daun-terang", "--daun-gelap"].map((n) => rgb(tok(n)));
      const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
      let seed = 7;
      // Acak berbiji: hasil sama setiap kali.
      const r = () => { seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0; let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed); t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t; return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
      const sv = (tag, at, parent) => { const e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag); Object.keys(at).forEach((k) => e.setAttribute(k, at[k])); if (parent) parent.appendChild(e); return e; };
      const dv = (cls, parent, css) => { const e = document.createElement("div"); e.className = cls; if (css) e.style.cssText = css; parent.appendChild(e); return e; };
      const rect = (x, y, w, h) => [[x, y], [x + w, y], [x + w, y + h], [x, y + h]];
      const ell = (cx, cy, rx, ry, n = 14) => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => [cx + Math.cos((i / n) * 6.283) * rx, cy + Math.sin((i / n) * 6.283) * ry]);
      function layers(id) {
        const L = { cam: document.getElementById(id), list: [] };
        L.ink = sv("svg", { class: "lay", width: 10, height: 10 }, L.cam);
        L.fol = dv("lay", L.cam);
        L.top = sv("svg", { class: "lay", width: 10, height: 10 }, L.cam);
        L.txt = dv("lay", L.cam);
        return L;
      }
      // Satu goresan pena: titik disisipkan tiap ~18 px dan digoyang, ujungnya melebihi sudut.
      function pen(L, pts, w = 2.4, col, svg = L.ink) {
        const q = [];
        pts.forEach((p, i) => {
          if (!i) return q.push(p);
          const [x0, y0] = pts[i - 1], n = Math.max(1, Math.round(Math.hypot(p[0] - x0, p[1] - y0) / 18));
          for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) q.push([x0 + ((p[0] - x0) * k) / n + (k < n ? (r() - 0.5) * 2.6 : 0), y0 + ((p[1] - y0) * k) / n + (k < n ? (r() - 0.5) * 2.6 : 0)]);
        });
        const ext = (a, b) => { const d = Math.hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1]) || 1; return [a[0] + ((a[0] - b[0]) / d) * 5, a[1] + ((a[1] - b[1]) / d) * 5]; };
        q.unshift(ext(q[0], q[1]));
        q.push(ext(q[q.length - 1], q[q.length - 2]));
        let d = "M" + q[0].join(" ");
        for (let i = 1; i < q.length - 1; i++) d += "Q" + q[i].join(" ") + " " + (q[i][0] + q[i + 1][0]) / 2 + " " + (q[i][1] + q[i + 1][1]) / 2;
        d += "L" + q[q.length - 1].join(" ");
        const p = sv("path", { d, pathLength: 1, class: "ink" }, svg);
        p.style.strokeWidth = w * 1.2;
        if (col) p.style.stroke = col;
        L.list.push(p);
        return p;
      }
      // Satu ruko, hanya garis: dinding, atap, jendela, pintu, tenda, lampion.
      function shopInk(L, x, g, w, h, k = 1) {
        const t = g - h, e = 48 * k, a = L.list.length, ay = g - h * 0.46, lx = x + w * 0.84, ly = t + h * 0.2 + 28 * k;
        pen(L, [[x, g], [x, t], [x + w, t], [x + w, g]], 2.6 * k);
        pen(L, [[x - 12 * k, t], [x + 24 * k, t - e], [x + w - 24 * k, t - e], [x + w + 12 * k, t]], 2.4 * k);
        for (let n = 1; n < w / (46 * k); n++) pen(L, [[x + n * 46 * k, t - 3], [x + n * 46 * k + (r() - 0.5) * 5, t - e + 4]], 1.4 * k);
        [0.16, 0.62].forEach((f) => {
          const wx = x + w * f, wy = t + h * 0.12, ww = w * 0.22, wh = h * 0.26;
          pen(L, [[wx, wy + wh], [wx, wy], [wx + ww, wy], [wx + ww, wy + wh]], 1.8 * k);
          pen(L, [[wx + ww / 2, wy + 4], [wx + ww / 2, wy + wh]], 1.2 * k);
        });
        pen(L, [[x + w * 0.38, g], [x + w * 0.38, g - h * 0.4], [x + w * 0.62, g - h * 0.4], [x + w * 0.62, g]], 2 * k);
        pen(L, Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, n) => [x + 6 + ((w - 12) * n) / 8, ay + (n % 2) * 14 * k]), 1.8 * k);
        pen(L, [[lx, t + 4], [lx, ly - 15 * k]], 1.2 * k);
        pen(L, [...ell(lx, ly, 11 * k, 15 * k, 10), ell(lx, ly, 11 * k, 15 * k, 10)[0]], 1.6 * k);
        return L.list.slice(a);
      }
      // Pohon, hanya garis: batang di bawah, tepi tajuk bergelombang di atas.
      function treeInk(L, c) {
        const a = L.list.length;
        pen(L, [[c.x - 12, 872], [c.x - 14, c.y + 60]], 2.4);
        pen(L, [[c.x + 12, 872], [c.x + 14, c.y + 70]], 2.4);
        pen(L, Array.from({ length: 13 }, (_, n) => { const an = 3.5 + n * 0.19, rr = c.r * 0.96 + (n % 2) * 12; return [c.x + Math.cos(an) * rr, c.y + Math.sin(an) * rr * 0.9]; }), 1.8, null, L.top);
        return L.list.slice(a);
      }
      // ---- Lukisan: dilukis sekali di kanvas berbiji (setengah resolusi), lalu jadi gambar diam ----
      function canvas(w, h) {
        const c = document.createElement("canvas");
        c.width = w / 2; c.height = h / 2;
        const x = c.getContext("2d");
        x.scale(0.5, 0.5);
        return { c, x };
      }
      function commit(P, host, left, top, w, h) {
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        Object.assign(img, { src: P.c["toDataURL"]("image/png") });
        img.className = "fol";
        img.style.cssText = `left:${left}px;top:${top}px;width:${w}px;height:${h}px`;
        host.appendChild(img);
        return img;
      }
      // Cat air: poligon bertepi kasar, meleset (+4, +3) dari garis, tepi kering lebih pekat.
      function fillPoly(x, pts, c, a) {
        const q = [];
        pts.forEach((v, i) => {
          const u = pts[(i + 1) % pts.length], n = Math.max(1, Math.round(Math.hypot(u[0] - v[0], u[1] - v[1]) / 30));
          for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) q.push([v[0] + ((u[0] - v[0]) * k) / n + (r() - 0.5) * 5 + 4, v[1] + ((u[1] - v[1]) * k) / n + (r() - 0.5) * 5 + 3]);
        });
        x.beginPath();
        q.forEach((p, i) => (i ? x.lineTo(p[0], p[1]) : x.moveTo(p[0], p[1])));
        x.closePath();
        x.fillStyle = rgba(c, a); x.fill();
        x.strokeStyle = rgba(mix(c, [40, 30, 30], 0.3), a * 0.6); x.lineWidth = 2.5; x.stroke();
      }
      // Langit: banyak noda biru bertumpuk, lalu celah awan dilubangi (kertas terlihat).
      function sky(x, x0, x1, gaps) {
        for (let n = 0; n < 120; n++) {
          x.fillStyle = rgba(r() < 0.7 ? Lg : mix(Lg, V, 0.3), 0.11 + r() * 0.08);
          x.beginPath();
          x.ellipse(x0 + r() * (x1 - x0), r() * 330, 120 + r() * 240, 50 + r() * 110, 0, 0, 6.283);
          x.fill();
        }
        x.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out";
        gaps.flatMap((g0) => [g0, ...Array.from({ length: 3 }, () => [g0[0] + (r() - 0.5) * g0[2] * 1.2, g0[1] + (r() - 0.5) * g0[3], g0[2] * (0.5 + r() * 0.4), g0[3] * (0.6 + r() * 0.5), g0[4]])]).forEach(([cx, cy, rx, ry, core]) => {
          x.save(); x.translate(cx, cy); x.scale(1, ry / rx);
          const g = x.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, rx);
          g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,1)"); g.addColorStop(core, "rgba(0,0,0,1)"); g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
          x.fillStyle = g; x.beginPath(); x.arc(0, 0, rx, 0, 6.283); x.fill(); x.restore();
        });
        x.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
      }
      const FAS = [mix(B, A, 0.3), B, mix(B, Lg, 0.5), mix(B, U, 0.3), mix(B, V, 0.22)];
      function paintShop(x, X, g, w, h, i, k = 1) {
        const t = g - h, e = 48 * k, ay = g - h * 0.46;
        fillPoly(x, rect(X + 5, t + 3, w - 8, h - 5), FAS[i % 5], 0.66);
        fillPoly(x, rect(X + w * 0.78, t + 3, w * 0.22 - 3, h - 5), V, 0.3);
        [0.16, 0.62].forEach((f) => fillPoly(x, rect(X + w * f, t + h * 0.12, w * 0.22, h * 0.26), V, 0.34));
        fillPoly(x, [[X - 8 * k, t], [X + 26 * k, t - e], [X + w - 26 * k, t - e], [X + w + 8 * k, t]], mix(A, V, 0.55), 0.8);
        fillPoly(x, rect(X + 8, ay, w - 16, 14 * k + 6), A, 0.72);
      }
      // Dedaunan: tajuk dari beberapa gumpalan, tepi gelap lalu ratusan noda kecil menurut arah cahaya.
      function crown(x, c0) {
        const tones = [DK, mix(U, DK, 0.55), U, mix(U, LT, 0.45), mix(LT, U, 0.3)];
